title: Gaugings of Groupoids, Strings in Shadows, and Emergent Poisson $σ$-Models
summary: The gauge principle is proposed for rigid Lie-groupoidal symmetries $G=>M$ of the Polyakov-Alvarez-Gawędzki 2$d$ non-linear $σ$-model with metric target $(M,g_M)$ and the WZ term given by a CS differential character coming from an abelian gerbe $\mathcal{G}$. The principle bases on the notion of principaloid bundle with connection $(P,Θ)$, introduced by Strobl and the Author.
